exposure: SpikoGen subunit vaccine administration during pregnancy
cohort: The participants were pregnant rats divided into control and vaccine administration groups.
finding: Administration of the SpikoGen vaccine during pregnancy had no significant negative effects on the weight, length, morphological development, or skeletal characteristics of rat fetuses.
birth_weight: Fetal weight was measured, with no significant effect observed.
gest_age: Fetal development was assessed on day 21 of gestation.
